[b]The Western View-Balladulah-Holy Orthodox Empire of Thýven Trade and Border Agreement (WVBHOETTBA)[/b]

[b]Whereas:[/b] The government of Thýven is seeking peace and stability across Erene through the establishment of economic ties with various nations to increase the fiscal situation of the continent of Shamat.

2. The nations involved shall permit the free flow of goods and services across the borders of these countries, maintaining the same policy as in sec. 1.

3. The Bank of Tharkønn, acting as the international broker for Thývens monetary policy and actions shall permit citizens and officers of the governments of Western-View and Balladulah to hold accounts within its structure, and the governments of Western-View and Balladulah shall permit the operation of branches of the Bank of Tharkønn within their nations.

4. Thýven shall maintain low tariffs of no greater than 10%  on all goods from Balladulah and Western-View, with those states offering preferential treatment in exchange maintaining also 10% minimum tariffs.

5. Thýven shall open per annum 1.2% of its annual gold reserves to the governments of Balladulah and Western-View in return for mineral and natural resources rights by the government of Thýven. [/list]

These shall be the terms of the trade deal, to be modified and ratified by all members.
